name: Siddament
summary: Australian filament brand operated by SIDDAMENT PTY LTD of North Parramatta, NSW, with the broadest catalogue of its peer group — PLA in a dozen finishes, PETG including fibre-filled grades, ABS/ASA, PC, PA6-CF/PA12-CF, PVA and four TPU durometers — alongside resold Proto-Pasta and Prusa product, printers and its own tooling. The company does not extrude in Australia: the site openly states its stock originates in China, with an on-site banner announcing 'SIDD'S IN CHINA - 3-4 DAY LEAD TIME', so it is an Australian-HQ importer and retailer rather than a manufacturer.

oem_relationships.notes: Siddament's own site places its sourcing and lead times in China, but names no factory, mill or supplier for any line. The house filament is therefore contract-produced by one or more undisclosed Chinese extruders; no specific company is recorded because none was identified.
Third-party brand resold through the Siddament store, not produced by Siddament.
Prusament filament (e.g. PETG Tungsten 75%, PETG Clear), Prusa pellets and Prusa printers are resold through the Siddament store.

product_lines.name: PLA (Normal)
product_lines.notes: Standard PLA; also covers the Translucent and Tri/Dual Colour colourways, which are pigment and coextrusion variants of the same base with no separate id in the catalog.

product_lines.name: Matte PLA / Matte PLA V2
product_lines.notes: Matte-additive PLA, two generations; colourways include Matte Black/White/Grey/Red/Orange/Green/Yellow/Blue/Purple, Matte Cotton White and Matte Marble. Marble here is a matte colourway, not a mineral-filled grade, so pla-stone is not asserted.

product_lines.name: Fluro / Glow PLA
product_lines.notes: Sold as a combined fluorescent and glow line; pla-glow covers the phosphorescent variants, while the purely fluorescent colours are pigment-only PLA with no distinct id.

product_lines.name: Infused PLA
product_lines.notes: Line name discloses no filler; without knowing what it is infused with, no wood, metal, stone or glitter id can be assigned and the base chemistry id is used.

product_lines.name: PETG (Normal, V2)
product_lines.notes: Standard PETG in Black, White, Grey and Transparent plus a V2 Black; the Matte and Metallic PETG variants are cosmetic-additive versions of the same base and the catalog has no matte or metallic PETG id.

product_lines.name: ASA
product_lines.notes: Weatherable ASA in black and white.

product_lines.name: PCCF (Polycarbonate Carbon Fiber)
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled polycarbonate. The catalog has pc-gf but no pc-cf id, so this maps to the base pc chemistry pending a dedicated id; see gaps.

additional_notes: Legal entity SIDDAMENT PTY LTD is confirmed through the buy.nsw.gov.au supplier registry and a Cylex Australia business listing, both placing it in North Parramatta, NSW. Trial rolls start at $8.99 AUD with full spools scaling up; the storefront spans roughly 1,245 SKUs once colours and formats are counted. Own-brand tooling includes the 'Cuttament' filament cutter and 'Stringum Obliterus' stringing remedy, plus bed-adhesion powder/glue, hotends and spare parts; build plates and print sheets are stocked but there is no evidence they are Siddament-manufactured rather than resold, so makes_plates is deliberately left unset. Printers sold (Core One+, Core One L XL, Prusa Pro HT90, BIQU units) are third-party hardware. A Creality forum thread raised a customer-service complaint — filament shipped in vacuum bags rather than boxes as a cost saving, a blunt reply to the complaint, and the complaint reportedly reposted publicly to the company's Facebook page; no filament quality defect was alleged in that thread, so it is a service reputation flag only.

provenance.conflicts: China origin is stated by the company in shipping copy rather than as a formal country-of-origin declaration, and no factory or supplier is named, so the actual extruder is unknown and per-line origin may vary. The line between house-brand and resold stock is blurry — Proto-Pasta, Prusament, Prusa pellets, printers and probably the build plates are third-party, and only the Siddament-branded filament is recorded in product_lines. Trustpilot returned 403 and filament.uno's manufacturer page was fetch-blocked, so third-party reputation data could not be independently verified. The 'Infused' PLA line's filler is undisclosed.
